fieldValues.comment_text:
Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** Names the mechanism and a candidate shape: 'Affirming everything just becomes a chore... and then I just click recommended', 'affirming things I can't review', 'Affirmation breaks the better version of the cycle', 'affirmation will just kill lots of this work'. A lighter form is floated: 'We may not want the whole affirmation requirement, but a tick and bin on derived data would be valuable.' The owner still cannot 'properly work out how to manage affirmations'.

**Proposed.** Agents propose structure as separate records and I am asked to affirm each one. It becomes a chore of things I cannot properly review, so I click 'recommended', the cycle of building meaning stalls, and the meaning layer stays unaffirmed or is affirmed without being read.

**Depth.** 8 vignettes (2 retell, 6 touch); strong recurrence of the same frustration, with one partial remedy idea (tick and bin). Dates not checked here.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
